parseString (JsonUtil.h:55-60) and parseBool search '"key":' then '"key": ', but parseInt and parseBool then skip any run of spaces (JsonUtil.cpp:32, JsonUtil.h:118), and parseInt hands the rest to strtol (parse.cpp:17), which skips a newline or tab, so only parseString and parseBool read a newline-after-colon as missing; the one-space limit is written nowhere, JsonUtil.h:12 claiming 'optional whitespace'.

doc(), changed() and status() call takeAnswers() and the first two call refreshIfDue for a Feed (JsonFetch.cpp:296-318), but fetch() itself sets dueAt=now and calls refreshIfDue on registration (122-139) and on every repeat call, so an unread feed is fetched once when registered and on each fetch() call, not never; status() does not refresh; JsonFetch.h:33 already writes 'fetched again when read after periodMs'.

grep SpscRing across src finds only platform_desktop_audio.cpp:68 (miniaudio thread to AudioService) and JsonFetch.h:119-120 (jobs_ and answers_); supporting.md:33 describes the ring but names no user.
